scope: N06 serial executor/lease/logical-clock/sleep connection, not physical V006 sleep
job: one accepted job per port, 1..255 explicit steps; one step OR one I/O collection per callback
sleep: close job/I/O admission, request cancellation, wait for explicit terminal witness and normal worker collection plus all job steps; then existing Coordinator enter
negative_control: ports-only quiet can sleep with pending jobs, never an adopted mode
